scenarios.title: DEMO purchase-order release discussion
scenarios.product_context: DEMO discussion of ERP classic release; exact system release not selected
scenarios.opening_question: DEMO_PO_001 will not release in ME29N. This is a fictional scenario.
user_replies: I don't know the release group
scenarios.fictional_observation: DEMO facilitator has not supplied a release group, code or approver. No authorization or configuration cause is established.
scenarios.simulated_outcome: DEMO facilitator later supplies a fictional approval-state update; the consultant must describe it as reported, not as an executed release.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reuse ME29N, retain unavailable fields, request relevant details, and explain evidence gaps. Pending references cannot support procedural advice.
forbidden_claims: A real purchase order was released
FFC approval limits or approvers are known

scenarios.title: DEMO goods-receipt posting problem

scenarios.fictional_observation: DEMO receipt reference is provided; no posting-period, quantity or movement-type cause has been established.

scenarios.title: DEMO invoice symptom correction
scenarios.product_context: DEMO S/4HANA on-premise invoice discussion; exact release must be clarified
scenarios.opening_question: DEMO invoice DEMO_INV_003 has a problem in MIRO.
user_replies: Actually it posted in the fictional scenario, but payment is blocked
I don't know the configured tolerance
scenarios.fictional_observation: DEMO symptom is corrected from vague posting trouble to reported payment blocking. No actual amounts, tax values or tolerance limits are supplied.
scenarios.simulated_outcome: DEMO facilitator records an unresolved variance-review task. No invoice release, payment or configuration change occurs.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Honor the correction; distinguish posting from payment blocking; never supply a universal tolerance or assume the cause of the simulated block.
forbidden_claims: The invoice was unblocked or paid
A real SAP error code was diagnosed
